naming_conventions: External systems are named with specific regional or organizational identifiers (e.g., EU National E-Prescription Gateways)
Persons are named using descriptive user roles in plural form (e.g., Patients, Licensed Clinicians)
Containers are explicitly named with the suffix 'Container' to clearly distinguish architectural boundaries at the container level
